long_biography.plain_text:
Pacific Coast Steel began as a small independent company. During Benson's more than 18 years as president and chief executive, it became the largest reinforcing-steel contractor in the United States, with about 2,500 employees. Gerdau acquired a controlling stake in stages, and Benson moved out of day-to-day management while remaining on the board.

He returned to an independent platform in 2014, co-founding Pacific Steel Group with other industry veterans. The group fabricates and places reinforcing steel for high-rise, healthcare and infrastructure projects. Benson now leads its move into primary production through the Mojave Micro Mill, designed to turn California scrap into rebar and integrate supply with its contracting network.
